walk.stroke_basis: Wider coordinated foot path: 96 mm stance sweep, centered 8 mm forward. Retains the previous full-Walk lift and body sway/bob/roll/pitch; Home calibration is unchanged. Calculated using saved mirrored carrier 856/2444 us, crank 723/2577 us, and 11.111111 us/degree.

leverage_validation.scope: Offline gait regression margins, not measured torque limits or servo pulse caps.
